criteria.description: The generator builds the whole package into opendesign/spec-kitty-train/; USAGE.md and DESIGN.md's prose are authored and prose-checked (FR amended)
criteria.evidence: scripts/build-opendesign-package.mjs buildPackage(); `node scripts/build-opendesign-package.mjs --check` → current: 34 components, 157 static forms
criteria.notes: Verified at the REL4 fix head; the four-lens gate re-runs on the pushed head.

criteria.description: components.html and every components/<name>.html are static-only
criteria.evidence: staticOnlyProblems() asserted over components.html and each page in buildPackage(); selftest probes refuse a custom tag, a <script> and a declarative shadow root, and two controls (native markup; CSS not scanned) pass
criteria.notes: Verified at the REL4 fix head; the four-lens gate re-runs on the pushed head.

criteria.description: Every component with a static form is covered with every static form, derived from the tree
criteria.evidence: derive() takes every .html per styles dir; probe 'taken + omitted = every .html on disk'; output-side probes find each form's full rendered figure in its committed page and its components.html section (mutant-tested after regeneration)
criteria.notes: Verified at the REL4 fix head; the four-lens gate re-runs on the pushed head.

criteria.description: Excluded elements and omitted forms are named in DESIGN.md, derived
criteria.evidence: buildDesignRegion() → 16 excluded elements, 2 omitted boundary-page forms with reasons; probes 'names excluded elements', 'omitted form named with its reason'
criteria.notes: Verified at the REL4 fix head; the four-lens gate re-runs on the pushed head.

criteria.evidence: derive() uses buildTokensCss(src); probe 'tokens.css is the PUBLISHED stylesheet' incl. :root:not([data-theme]); drift probe on a one-byte change
criteria.notes: Verified at the REL4 fix head; the four-lens gate re-runs on the pushed head.

criteria.description: components.manifest.json is derived by OpenDesign's own extractor, vendored byte-for-byte and digest-verified before import
criteria.evidence: scripts/vendor/open-design/ at c5ae6292c4; opendesign-reference.mjs verifyVendor()+6 probes; independently confirmed equal to upstream by two review lenses (git show | sha256sum)
criteria.notes: Verified at the REL4 fix head; the four-lens gate re-runs on the pushed head.

criteria.description: manifest.json passes OpenDesign's own validator and declares files.components and componentsManifest
criteria.evidence: parseDesignSystemProjectManifest() in buildPackage(); drift probe that the validator rejects an unknown key
criteria.notes: Verified at the REL4 fix head; the four-lens gate re-runs on the pushed head.

criteria.description: The package records the library version and branch, no self-SHA
criteria.evidence: buildManifest() description carries @spec-kitty/* versions, source.branch; probe 'the manifest records no commit SHA'
criteria.notes: Verified at the REL4 fix head; the four-lens gate re-runs on the pushed head.

criteria.description: --check reds on drift and is wired through all three gate-wiring layers
criteria.evidence: ci-quality.yml lint-code steps; check-gate-wiring REQUIRED_LINT; 51 defeat cases, including write-mode regeneration (package and size record), NODE_OPTIONS (env: at every level, lower-case key, $GITHUB_ENV) and default-shell overrides; build-opendesign-package.mjs --selftest runs 53 unit and 17 drift probes
criteria.notes: Verified at the REL4 fix head; the four-lens gate re-runs on the pushed head.

criteria.description: An empty or shrunken set is refused
criteria.evidence: derive() refuses zero components/forms (probe drives derive() over a fixture tree where every form composes a custom element; revert-tested red); diffPackage refuses an empty file set (drift probe)
criteria.notes: Verified at the REL4 fix head; the four-lens gate re-runs on the pushed head.

criteria.description: The release path refuses a stale package
criteria.evidence: publish-packages.yml and release.yml run the exact, unconditional --check before any bump; check-release-graph enforces presence, order, exact run and no if: (probes incl. || true, echo, if: false); also refuses a shell override, a write-mode regeneration step and a NODE_OPTIONS preload (env: or $GITHUB_ENV)
criteria.notes: Verified at the REL4 fix head; the four-lens gate re-runs on the pushed head.
